notes.content: Admission Recommendations for the Leavey School of Business

Thank you for your interest in Santa Clara University! This guide has been designed to help make the course-planning process easier for students who wish to transfer to Santa Clara University. Head to our Transfer Guides page for more details on the credit transfer process. Leavey School of Business Admission Recommendations for Transfer Students : This page shows the SCU Core and Leavey School of Business courses recommended for transferring to Santa Clara University. While there are no transfer requirements, we recommend prioritizing the following in your application. Bachelor of Science in Commerce majors: Accounting, Accounting and Information Systems, Economics, Finance, Management, Marketing, Management Information Systems Courses strongly recommended for admission: Two English composition courses One-Two Calculus courses MATHEMATICS: Starting Fall 2024 Finance and Economics majors require two Calculus courses (Calculus 1 and 2). All other business majors only require Calculus 1. One Macroeconomics course and One Microeconomics course One Financial Accounting Course and One Managerial Accounting Course GPA 3.5 You may also choose to complete other SCU Course requirements listed below before transferring. *NOTE: Business majors will complete their Cultures & Ideas 3 class and Ethics class upon enrollment at SCU. Economics courses will fulfill the Social Sciences requirement. Additional recommendations specific to the Leavey School of Business are listed at the bottom of this page. View our Transfer Guides page for more details.
notes.contentHtml:
Thank you for your interest in Santa Clara University! This guide has been designed to help make the course-planning process easier for students who wish to transfer to Santa Clara University. Head to our Transfer Guides page for more details on the credit transfer process.


Leavey School of Business Admission Recommendations for Transfer Students:

This page shows the SCU Core and Leavey School of Business courses recommended for transferring to Santa Clara University. While there are no transfer requirements, we recommend prioritizing the following in your application.


Bachelor of Science in Commerce majors: Accounting, Accounting and Information Systems, Economics, Finance, Management, Marketing, Management Information Systems Courses strongly recommended for admission:

  • Two English composition courses
  • One-Two Calculus courses
  • MATHEMATICS: Starting Fall 2024 Finance and Economics majors require two Calculus courses (Calculus 1 and 2). All other business majors only require Calculus 1. 
  • One Macroeconomics course and One Microeconomics course
  • One Financial Accounting Course and One Managerial Accounting Course
  • GPA 3.5 


You may also choose to complete other SCU Course requirements listed below before transferring.


*NOTE: Business majors will complete their Cultures & Ideas 3 class and Ethics class upon enrollment at SCU. Economics courses will fulfill the Social Sciences requirement. Additional recommendations specific to the Leavey School of Business are listed at the bottom of this page. View our Transfer Guides page for more details.

notes.content: Structure of Santa Clara University General Core To view the Santa Clara University core curriculum requirements check out our Core Curriculum page. Some Core requirements must be met at SCU: Civic Engagement, Religion Theology & Culture 2, Science Technology & Society, Religion Theology & Culture 3, Experiential Learning for Social Justice, Advanced Writing, and Pathways. Moreover, no courses listed in this guide can fulfill more than one core requirement. Navigating this Guide The first courses listed on this page are the recommended courses for admission to SCU . We do not have particular requirements for transferring, but we do recommend you complete most of the courses tagged as "Recommended Courses" below and meet the recommended GPA. The remaining courses listed will fulfill university core requirements or Leavey School of Business requirements. *NOTE: Courses with a co-requisite must be completed together to meet the requirement

notes.text: Admission Recommendations for the Leavey School of Business

Thank you for your interest in Santa Clara University! This guide has been designed to help make the course-planning process easier for students who wish to transfer to Santa Clara University. Head to our Transfer Guides page for more details on the credit transfer process.

Leavey School of Business Admission Recommendations for Transfer Students:
This page shows the SCU Core and Leavey School of Business courses recommended for transferring to Santa Clara University. While there are no transfer requirements, we recommend prioritizing the following in your application.

Bachelor of Science in Commerce majors: Accounting, Accounting and Information Systems, Economics, Finance, Management, Marketing, Management Information Systems Courses strongly recommended for admission:
Two English composition courses
One-Two Calculus courses
MATHEMATICS: Starting Fall 2024 Finance and Economics majors require two Calculus courses (Calculus 1 and 2). All other business majors only require Calculus 1. 
One Macroeconomics course and One Microeconomics course
One Financial Accounting Course and One Managerial Accounting Course
GPA 3.5 

You may also choose to complete other SCU Course requirements listed below before transferring.

*NOTE: Business majors will complete their Cultures & Ideas 3 class and Ethics class upon enrollment at SCU. Economics courses will fulfill the Social Sciences requirement. Additional recommendations specific to the Leavey School of Business are listed at the bottom of this page. View our Transfer Guides page for more details.

Structure of Santa Clara University General Core

To view the Santa Clara University core curriculum requirements check out our Core Curriculum page.
Some Core requirements must be met at SCU: Civic Engagement, Religion Theology & Culture 2, Science Technology & Society, Religion Theology & Culture 3, Experiential Learning for Social Justice, Advanced Writing, and Pathways.
Moreover, no courses listed in this guide can fulfill more than one core requirement.

Navigating this Guide

The first courses listed on this page are the recommended courses for admission to SCU. We do not have particular requirements for transferring, but we do recommend you complete most of the courses tagged as "Recommended Courses" below and meet the recommended GPA. The remaining courses listed will fulfill university core requirements or Leavey School of Business requirements.

*NOTE: Courses with a co-requisite must be completed together to meet the requirement
